subject: Security walkthrough: aligning SOC 2 + pen test + DPA timing

Subject: Request: security walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks for guiding us here. We're preparing for a combined SOC 2 intake, pen test orientation, and a quick DPA alignment (high level) for Clearbank's upcoming review. We want to do a single 90-minute walkthrough covering: scope alignment, evidence handoff options, pen-test vendor access model, and DPA items that may affect evidence sharing.

Are you available the week of May 12–16? Our preference is late afternoon CET (so it catches London & our US ops on early morning) but we're flexible. Attendees will include our security operations lead (Oliver Hayes) and two platform engineers; I've attached the initial questionnaire and a rough attendee list.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers a separate ops bridge for the pen vendor, or if you can host the vendor on the same bridge?
- Any pre-reads we should review?

Thanks — Emma

--

Clearbank Ltd.

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and the attachments, reviewing now.

We can definitely run a combined session. A couple of notes up front: we typically allocate 60–90 minutes depending on how deep the pen vendor onboarding goes. We can host the vendor on the same ops bridge (cleanest for triage) but for access-sensitive moments we ask customers to mute or use a separate breakout — Ben will explain the handoff.

Proposed slots (all CET):
- Wed May 14, 16:00–17:30 CET
- Fri May 16, 11:00–12:30 CET

If you need a US-friendly morning (PDT), we can do Friday May 16 at 09:00–10:30 PDT (which is 18:00–19:30 CET). Please let us know a preferred slot and whether the pen vendor will attend live or just receive an access brief.

I've looped in Ben (security engineer) and Laura (customer success) so they can scope the agenda and set the pre-read. Ben — can you confirm the evidence upload options and whether we'll request temporary SFTP creds or use a secure Share (Drive transfer + audit)?

Best,
Kimberly

- Where: Zoom (Redwood ops bridge) — https://zoom.redwood.example/meet/secure-ops-1432
- Calendar invite: attached (calendar-invite.ics) — invite will go to your calendar in a minute.

1) Introductions & scope alignment (10 min)
2) SOC 2 control mapping and evidence path (25 min) — Laura to cover evidence handoff options
3) Pen test orientation & vendor logistics (30 min) — Ben to run vendor sequence and temp access model
4) DPA high-level items & signatures (10 min) — share DocuSign link for DPA follow-up
5) Q&A & contingency (15–30 min) — audit log outflow expectations handled as contingency

- Ben: we'll prepare two evidence transfer options (SFTP temporary creds vs. encrypted Drive share) and bring a short runbook.
- Laura: I'll include a short slide with recommended evidence sets by SOC 2 domain.
- Emma/Oliver: if you want us to circulate a short NDA/DPA redline prior to the meeting, we can — otherwise we'll use the DocuSign link live and capture signatures post-call.

DocuSign link (for post-call DPA formalization): https://docusign.example.com/XYZ-987654
